subject: Payment gating & invoice format — procurement readiness for OffGrid Labs
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@offgridlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Payment gating & invoice format — procurement readiness for OffGrid Labs

Hi Amit,

Thanks again for a productive call earlier — great to learn more about OffGrid's rollout timeline and procurement constraints. Per our discussion, wanted to summarize the items that will unblock a commercial path and surface a couple quick asks your finance/procurement team can answer inline.

High-level recap (from call):
- Desired launch: pilot with 2 teams (internal analytics + field ops) in Nov.
- Expected monthly consumption: ~10M tokens (spiky, but tolerant to burst).
- Procurement path: leaning toward PO + net-30 rather than card; marketplace option is a maybe but not preferred due to existing vendor vetting.

Questions / gating checklist for billing ops (please confirm):
1) Billing entity and legal name to appear on invoices (exact string)
2) Billing address and VAT/tax ID (if applicable)
3) Preferred invoice frequency (monthly vs. milestone) and net terms you require
4) Do you need invoices in a particular CSV/ERP layout (we can provide sample CSV)
5) Will procurement require a signed SOW or will PO be sufficient to start?
6) Any special remittance instructions or AP contact name/email

Attached: redwood-invoice-sample.csv (sample fields we can emit) and a short SOW template for reference. If helpful, I can loop in our finance lead (Marissa) on the next thread to confirm format and net terms.

Proposed next steps:
- Amit / Priya: confirm items 1–6 above by EOD Wed so we can create a PO-ready proposal.
- Rachel: send draft commercial proposal + sample invoice on Thu.
- Marissa: be on standby to review invoice layout & finalize net terms.

Thanks — short responses welcome.

Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-invoice-sample.csv]
[Attachment: redwood-sow-template.pdf]

From: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@offgridlabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@offgridlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Payment gating & invoice format — procurement readiness for OffGrid Labs

Thanks Rachel — appreciated the recap. Quick answers from our side (procurement & finance):

1) Billing name: OffGrid Labs, Inc.
2) Billing address: 120 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107
   Tax/VAT: US EIN 12-3456789 (no VAT)
3) Invoice frequency: monthly invoices are preferred; net-30 is standard for us.
4) ERP format: Our AR system (Coupa) prefers CSV with columns: Invoice#, InvoiceDate, PO#, LineDescription, Quantity, UnitPrice, Tax, Total, VendorTaxID. Your sample looks close; if you can map to those columns that’d be ideal.
5) SOW: Procurement wants a short SOW attaching to the PO for pilot scope (1 page ok).
6) AP contact: Priya Singh (priya.singh@offgridlabs.com) — include PO# on invoice and send PDF to ap@offgridlabs-payables.com

One more note: we will need Redwood's W-9 for vendor onboarding. Can you attach?

If all that matches, I'll have Procurement issue a PO next week. We're not trying marketplace billing right now — prefer direct invoicing.

—Amit
Head of Platform, OffGrid Labs
amit.joshi@offgridlabs.com | +1 (650) 555-4410

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-13T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Payment gating & invoice format — procurement readiness for OffGrid Labs

Rachel / Vivek — forwarding Amit's answers. TL;DR: net-30 monthly, PO required, Coupa CSV mapping requested, W-9 needed.

Action items for finance ops (Marissa):
- I'll generate an invoice template mapped to the Coupa columns Amit listed.
- Add Redwood's W-9 and vendor information.
- Confirm whether we can include Invoice# and PO# fields dynamically (yes).

Vivek: can your invoicing pipeline export the CSV columns Amit specified? If not, we should offer a flat PDF invoice + a separate CSV.

I'll prep a one-page SOW template (pilot scope + acceptance) and send to Rachel for PO creation.

Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Great — this is exactly what we needed, thanks Amit. Quick confirm and next steps: 

- We'll deliver: monthly PDF invoice + CSV export matching Coupa columns.
- Net terms: net-30.
- SOW: Marissa will share a one-page pilot SOW by EOD today, which you can attach to the PO.
- W-9: attaching Redwood's W-9 and vendor info (Marissa confirmed).
- DocuSign: I'll send a short commercial proposal + SOW via DocuSign for signature once you share the PO#.

If Procurement issues PO next week we can start provisioning dedicated capacity for the pilot the week after (rough timeline). I'll drop a HubSpot activity for follow-up on Oct 20.

Thanks — will follow up with the DocuSign link.
